observation.visible_scene: A dance studio with a full-length mirrored wall on the left, draped teal curtains on the right and back, a ballet barre, a floor fan, and a potted plant. A woman in a white tank top and beige wide-leg pants stands on the light wood floor, her mirrored reflection visible on the left.
visible_changes: At the start (t=0.0) the woman's arms are raised out to the sides, bent at the elbows. Over the first ~0.3 s she sweeps both arms upward until they are fully extended overhead.
As the arms rise, her hands/wrists converge and cross above her head, forming a narrow vertical 'X' shape that is then held for the rest of the segment.
Her head tilts progressively backward and her torso arches/open the chest, deepening slightly from the upright start into a sustained backbend pose with chin and face turned upward.
Her lower-body stance (one foot turned out with heel lifted, the other planted) remains essentially unchanged throughout.
The mirror reflection reproduces the same arm-raising and backbend sequence in sync.
Background elements (right curtain, fan, plant) and the woman's position within the frame shift gradually in scale and placement, indicating a slow camera drift/zoom rather than subject translation.
outside_clip_unknowns: What preceded the arm-raising and what follows the held backbend (e.g., whether she lowers her arms or transitions to another movement) are outside this cropped segment.
The purpose or name of the exercise is not determinable from the visuals.
uncertain_details: Whether the small change in framing is a camera pan, dolly, or zoom cannot be resolved from the background alone.
The exact hand configuration overhead (wrists crossed vs. fingers touching) is hard to resolve at this resolution.
The degree of backbend change between mid and late frames is subtle and may be partly pose settling rather than active motion.
